User story: As a user I want to log in with my username and password so that I see my own dashboard.
Acceptance criteria: Given a valid account, when I log in, then I see the dashboard for my role. Given a wrong password 5 times, then the account is locked for 15 minutes and the event is in the security log.

User story: As the Super Admin I want five roles with their own permissions so that each person only sees what they need.
Acceptance criteria: Given a student, when they open an admin page, then they get 'access denied' and the attempt is logged.

User story: As an admin I want two-step login (MFA) so that my account is safe even if my password leaks.
Acceptance criteria: Given MFA is on, when I log in, then I must type a 6-digit code. The Super Admin can switch MFA on or off for any user.

User story: As the Super Admin I want to 'Login as' any user so that I can test their screens.
Acceptance criteria: Given I give a reason, when I start Login as, then a red bar shows who I am viewing as, and start and stop are in the security log.

User story: As a teacher or admin I want to reset my forgotten password by email, WhatsApp or Viber.
Acceptance criteria: Given any username, then the page shows the same message (no account hints). The link works once, for 1 hour. Students are reset by their teacher.

User story: As the Super Admin I want to add schools so that each school has its own space.
Acceptance criteria: Given a new school, then it gets a clean code and a free 30-day trial licence.

User story: As a School Admin I want classes and sections with a 35-student limit so that classes stay manageable.
Acceptance criteria: Given a section with 35 students, when I add one more, then I see 'section is full'. Only the Super Admin can change the capacity (1–60).

User story: As a School Admin I want to import students from a CSV file with a preview.
Acceptance criteria: Given a CSV file, then I see a preview with errors before anything is saved.

User story: As a School Admin I want to record family consent so that only consented students take part.
Acceptance criteria: Given consent is missing, then the student is listed on the School Admin dashboard.

User story: As a student I want six levels that match my year group so that the content suits my age.
Acceptance criteria: Given Level 1 (Year 7) is free, then Levels 2–6 open only when the school owns the Level Pack and I passed the level before.

User story: As a student I want short topics with examples, pictures and videos.
Acceptance criteria: Given a topic page, then I see the text, good habits, a Kiwi example and any approved media.

User story: As a student I want to practise with instant feedback so that I learn from mistakes.
Acceptance criteria: Given a practice answer, then I see right or wrong, the reason and a safety tip. Practice never counts against me.

User story: As a student I want a 20-question level exam so that I can prove what I know.
Acceptance criteria: Given an assigned exam, then I get 4 categories × 5 questions × 5 marks = 100. 70% or more passes and unlocks the next level.

User story: As a teacher I want to assign level exams to a section with a due date.
Acceptance criteria: Given an assignment, then students in that section see the exam button and get a notice.

User story: As a teacher I want to write extra practice questions for my school.
Acceptance criteria: Given a new question, then it needs 2–4 answers and feedback, and it is used only in my school's practice.

User story: As a School Admin I want plans and Level Packs so that the school pays for what it uses.
Acceptance criteria: Given Basic, Standard or Unlimited, then the section limit and price follow the plan rules.

User story: As a kura or small rural school I want a 50% community discount.
Acceptance criteria: Given the discount is on, then every plan price is halved on quotes and receipts.

User story: As the Super Admin I want product keys so that schools without internet can activate.
Acceptance criteria: Given a key with a wrong check code, then it is rejected. A valid key sets the plan and expiry.

User story: As any user I want notices on my dashboard (exam assigned, level unlocked, payment reviewed).
Acceptance criteria: Given an event, then the right people get one notice; the bell shows the unread number.

User story: As any user I want to raise a ticket and follow it with a number.
Acceptance criteria: Given a ticket, then it gets a CQ number, goes to the right person and has a target time. Status moves follow the allowed steps only.

User story: As a student I want to report a question that looks wrong.
Acceptance criteria: Given a report, then my teacher gets a content ticket linked to the question.

User story: As the Super Admin I want editable email templates and Gmail sending.
Acceptance criteria: Given Gmail is not set up, then emails go to the console and the email log; nothing breaks.

User story: As a School Admin I want to email opted-in parents with a preview and an unsubscribe link.
Acceptance criteria: Given a bulk email, then I see how many people it goes to first; only opted-in parents are included.

User story: As the Super Admin I want one page to add AI, Gmail, Maps, WhatsApp and Viber keys safely.
Acceptance criteria: Given a key, then it is saved encrypted, shown masked, can be tested, and every change is logged.

User story: As the Super Admin I want an AI test page to check an AI key works.
Acceptance criteria: Given no key, then the offline helper answers.

User story: As the Super Admin I want a business intelligence dashboard.
Acceptance criteria: Given demo data, then I see schools, students, exams, pass rate, monthly income, plans, tickets and payments to review.

User story: As a teacher I want class reports with the weakest topics first, as CSV and PDF.
Acceptance criteria: Given a section, then I see one row per student with first names only, and can download CSV and PDF.

User story: As a School Admin I want to pay by bank transfer and upload the payslip.
Acceptance criteria: Given a quote, then GST 15% is shown; a payslip that is not a real PDF or picture is rejected.

User story: As the Super Admin I want to approve or reject payslips and give a tax receipt.
Acceptance criteria: Given approval, then the plan or pack starts at once and a PDF receipt is available; rejection needs a reason.

User story: As a student I want a PDF certificate for each level I pass.
Acceptance criteria: Given a passed exam, then a certificate with a QR code is made; the public check page shows my first name only.

User story: As any user I want 'Explain this page' and a help centre.
Acceptance criteria: Given any page, then the side panel shows the guide for my role and I can ask the helper a question.

User story: As an admin I want to post announcements (Pānui) for a school or everyone.
Acceptance criteria: Given an audience and dates, then only the right people see it, only between those dates.

User story: As a teacher I want AI drafts of questions, tips and parent messages.
Acceptance criteria: Given a draft, then names and emails are removed before sending, and it cannot be published without teacher approval.

User story: As the Kaiārahi I want to approve AI text and media with Māori content before students see it.
Community / Te Tiriti need: Protection of taonga and te reo
Acceptance criteria: Given Māori content is found, then the draft or file stays hidden until a Cultural Guide approves it.

User story: As a teacher I want to upload pictures, audio, video and add YouTube videos.
Acceptance criteria: Given a renamed .exe called photo.jpg, then it is rejected and logged; YouTube plays in privacy mode.

User story: As a visitor with low vision I want dark mode and larger text.
Acceptance criteria: Given I press Dark mode or Larger text, then the page changes and remembers my choice.

User story: As the Super Admin I want backups, a health check and feature switches.
Acceptance criteria: Given /health/, then the database, disk and media checks show OK; a backup can be made and restored with a typed confirmation word.

User story: As a school IT person I want to start CyberQuest with one double-click.
Acceptance criteria: Given Docker, when I run run.bat, then it picks a free port (8000–8020), creates secrets and opens the browser.

User story: As a visitor I want a public website that explains the problem and the product.
Acceptance criteria: Given the home page, then I see the problem, NZ facts and law, the solution, features and the architecture.

User story: As the client I want proof that the system works (tests, code quality, evidence).
Acceptance criteria: Given the release, then all automated tests pass, Pylint is 10/10 and evidence screenshots exist.

User story: As a student I want a class leaderboard.
Acceptance criteria: Kept as a switched-off feature switch; not built as a page after cultural advice.

User story: As a student I want hands-on hacking labs.
Acceptance criteria: Removed: not suitable or legal for school students.
